UNDERTAKING REGARDING IBCC EQUIVALENCE CERTIFICATE
(Only for Foreign Students)
I, _________________________________________________________, Passport No. ___________________________,
hereby undertake that I shall submit my valid IBCC Equivalence Certificate within ninety (90) days from the date of
issuance/receipt of the University's admission letter.
I understand that my eligibility for admission shall be determined only upon submission and verification of the IBCC
Equivalence Certificate, irrespective of the stage of the degree program at which it is submitted. I further acknowledge that
my qualification must be equivalent to F.Sc. Pre-Engineering with at least 60% marks or fulfill the eligibility criteria
prescribed by the University.
I agree that if I fail to submit the Equivalence Certificate within the prescribed period, or if upon verification I am found
ineligible, my provisional admission may be cancelled at any stage of the degree program without prior notice.
I further undertake that I shall be solely responsible for any loss of time, tuition fees, academic progress, degree completion,
or any other consequences arising from delayed submission of the Equivalence Certificate or failure to meet the prescribed
eligibility criteria. The University shall bear no liability in this regard.
I shall not raise any claim or objection against the University regarding such cancellation of admission.
Student Signature: ___________________________
Student Name:
___________________________
Department Name:
___________________________
CNIC/Passport No.: ___________________________
Date: ___________________________
